# Company Profile

Wadi Lumen Software Co. is a web application developer based in Riyadh,
Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, founded in 2014.

Commercial registration: 1010-583216 (Riyadh).
Registered office: Office 412, Al Olaya Business Centre, King Fahd Road, Riyadh.
Headcount: 23 staff, of whom 16 are software developers, 3 are UI/UX designers
and 4 are quality assurance and support staff.

## What we do

We build bilingual (Arabic and English) customer-facing web portals and the
administration back-offices behind them, mostly for financial services firms
and government entities in Riyadh and Jeddah. Our platform is Microsoft .NET:
C#, ASP.NET MVC, jQuery and JavaScript on the front end, Microsoft SQL Server
as the database, deployed on Windows Server and IIS.

Typical engagements are fixed-price, three to six months, delivered by a team
of four to seven people.

## What we do not do in house

We do not build SMS gateways, payment or banking integrations, or document
management systems. Where a project needs these we integrate with a service
the client already operates, using the vendor's published API, and the client
supplies the credentials.
